title: Inter-Model Handshake Audit for Safe Hot-Swaps
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Maintain and modernize the compatibility ledger that ensures safe runtime switches between model variants used by smart routing policies (region selection, tier routing, and emergency hot-swaps). Goal: eliminate silent failures and user-visible regressions caused by tokenizer/context/tooling mismatches by delivering an audit, automated CI gates, and an operational rollback/playbook.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical compatibility ledger exists that maps model variant pairs to required compatibility properties (tokenizer version, context_size, kv_cache_format, expected toolchain versions)
Automated CI checks that run tokenization roundtrips across candidate variant pairs added to model catalog PRs
A runtime safety check (non-blocking initially) that annotates routing decisions with compatibility score and emits violations to Grafana/Alerting
Operational playbook covering detection, canary rollout steps, rollback criteria, and postmortem template is published
At least two historical incident cases reproduced in local harness and added to regression test suite
technical_notes: Tokenization parity policy: require exact tokenizer artifact hash match for automatic hot-swap. If hashes differ, require automated roundtrip test or a conversion shim approved by runtime team.
KV cache schema: define minor/major versioning. Major bumps require cache invalidation on variant switch or safe on-the-fly migration path in runtime.
Tooling parity: ensure fallback variants expose equivalent function signatures for tool-calling (function names, param schemas). Add schema checker to model onboarding pipeline.

Performance trade-off: stricter parity prevents silent errors but increases onboarding friction and storage for multiple tokenizer artifacts. Alternative is runtime conversion with CPU overhead; evaluate on a per-model basis.
CI harness: extend token-roundtrip container (docker://ghcr.io/redwood/harness/token-roundtrip:stable) to support randomized prompt batches and KV cache compatibility tests.

Telemetry: emit tag `variant_handshake_score` for each routed request; backend will aggregate 99th percentile mismatch events by route/region/tier. Alert threshold: >0.1% mismatches sustained over 5m.
Backward-compatibility gate: require product + runtime approval for any change that reduces handshake_score below 0.98 in pre-prod.
